chunks: Those who disbelieve and die in their disbelief — upon them is the curse of Allah, of the angels, and of all people.

key_terms.وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ: while they are disbelievers (indicating state at death)

ai.seo_question: Who bears the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the finality of divine curse for those who persist in disbelief until death, distinguishing it from temporary punishment. The inclusion of angels and humanity underscores a universal consensus in rejecting their state, reflecting the cosmic and social dimensions of kufr. This comprehensive condemnation serves as a warning against the stagnation of faith after initial belief.
